places.name: Chow Tai Fook Global Flagship (Canton Road)
places.name_zh: 周大福 全球首家旗艦店（廣東道）
places.intro: Chow Tai Fook's 10,000 sq ft global flagship, its largest store in Hong Kong and Macau, with a gold ginkgo tree and a heritage gallery.
must_order: Heritage gallery and gold ginkgo tree (free to see)
places.reviews: Press calls it the brand's showpiece; one buying guide found chain prices about 40% above online equivalents.
places.tips: Use it to browse and benchmark, then compare GIA-graded stones elsewhere before buying.
places.address_en: Shop G38C-D, G/F, Silvercord, 30 Canton Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon
places.address_zh: 九龍尖沙咀廣東道30號新港中心地下G38C-D號舖
places.maps_query: Chow Tai Fook Silvercord 30 Canton Road Tsim Sha Tsui

places.name: Chow Sang Sang (Hennessy Road, Causeway Bay)
places.name_zh: 周生生（銅鑼灣軒尼詩道分店）
places.intro: A two-floor branch of a major Hong Kong jewellery chain, about a 5-minute walk from The Park Lane.
places.reviews: A long-established, trusted chain; independent buying guides say chain diamonds cost more than online.
places.tips: Closest reputable option to the hotel; it opens late (listed 10:30/11am to 10pm).
places.address_en: G/F & 1/F, 525 Hennessy Road, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong
places.address_zh: 香港銅鑼灣軒尼詩道525號地下及1樓
places.maps_query: Chow Sang Sang 525 Hennessy Road Causeway Bay

places.name: Lukfook Jewellery (Causeway Bay, 499 Hennessy Road)
places.name_zh: 六福珠寶（銅鑼灣第十一分行）
places.intro: A multi-floor Causeway Bay branch of the QTS-accredited Lukfook chain, near the hotel.
must_order: Ask for the GIA report number
places.reviews: A trusted mass-market chain; one buying guide found a Lukfook ring about 75% above an identical online setup.
places.tips: Look for the QTS sticker at the door and get a full itemised receipt.
places.address_en: G/F, M/F, 1/F & 2/F, Wing Kwong Commercial Building, 499 Hennessy Road, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong
places.address_zh: 香港銅鑼灣軒尼詩道499號永光商業大廈地下、閣樓、一樓及二樓
places.maps_query: Lukfook Jewellery 499 Hennessy Road Causeway Bay

places.name: TSL Jewellery (Yee Wo Street, Causeway Bay)
places.intro: A Hong Kong diamond-led jewellery chain with a branch steps from The Park Lane.
must_order: Ask for the lab report number
places.reviews: A well-known local chain; independent guides give few detailed findings beyond the usual chain price premium.
places.tips: Easy to compare on the same evening walk as Chow Sang Sang and Lukfook.
places.address_en: Shop D-E, G/F, 1 Yee Wo Street, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong
places.address_zh: 香港銅鑼灣怡和街1號D-E地下
places.maps_query: TSL Jewellery 1 Yee Wo Street Causeway Bay

places.name: King Fook Jewellery (Central)
places.intro: A long-established, more upscale Hong Kong jeweller with a QTS listing, at its own headquarters building in Central.
must_order: Luxury watches (Patek Philippe retailer at its Pedder St boutique)
places.reviews: Known as one of Hong Kong's more reputable heritage jewellers; we found no recent independent diamond reviews.
places.tips: Its second Central boutique is at G21, Central Building, 1-3 Pedder Street.
places.address_en: G/F, King Fook Building, 30-32 Des Voeux Road Central, Central, Hong Kong
places.address_zh: 香港中環德輔道中30-32號景福大廈地下
places.maps_query: King Fook Jewellery 30-32 Des Voeux Road Central

places.name: Ronald Abram (by appointment)
places.intro: A specialist dealer in rare and estate diamonds that now sees clients by private appointment.
places.reviews: Highly regarded at the top end, but it is for serious budgets, not casual shopping.
places.tips: Book through the website enquiry form, which says it replies within two business days.
places.address_en: Suite 3208, 32/F, Alexandra House, 16-20 Chater Road, Central, Hong Kong (appointment only; confirm when booking)
places.address_zh: 香港中環遮打道16-20號歷山大廈32樓3208室
places.phone: +852 2525 1234 (from the brand's contact page; may be the old salon number)

places.name: The Canton Library
places.intro: Aqua Restaurant Group's new Cantonese restaurant and bar, opened September 2026 on the 29th floor of One Peking with harbour views.
must_order: Spanish red prawn with steamed egg white (HK$328)
Tea cocktails such as the Oolong Old Fashioned
places.reviews: Foodie (Oct 2026) praised the cooking and views but found it very pricey (about HK$1,600-1,800 for two), some dishes very salty and the dim sum ordinary.
places.tips: For a lighter visit, have tea cocktails at the bar; it is a 5-minute walk from the Star Ferry, and the Vesu Pizza Bar is one floor up.
places.address_en: 29/F, One Peking, 1 Peking Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon
places.address_zh: 九龍尖沙咀北京道1號北京道一號29樓
places.maps_query: The Canton Library One Peking Tsim Sha Tsui

places.name: Aqua
places.intro: A harbour-view Italian-Japanese restaurant and bar, now on the 17th floor of H Zentre (it moved from One Peking).
places.reviews: Diners rate the night view highly, but some on Tripadvisor found it pricey and called the tasting menu poor value.
places.tips: Book well ahead and ask for a window seat; it is in the same building as Hutong.
places.address_en: 17/F, H Zentre, 15 Middle Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon
places.address_zh: 九龍尖沙咀中間道15號H Zentre 17樓
places.maps_query: Aqua H Zentre 15 Middle Road Tsim Sha Tsui

places.name: Hutong
places.intro: A theatrical Northern Chinese restaurant with panoramic harbour views on the 18th floor of H Zentre.
places.reviews: Reviews praise the views and signature dishes, though it is expensive and the hours differ between listings.
places.tips: It is opposite TST MTR Exit L1 and a short walk from the Star Ferry; dinner runs daily from 5:30pm.
places.address_en: 18/F, H Zentre, 15 Middle Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon
places.address_zh: 九龍尖沙咀中間道15號H Zentre 18樓
places.maps_query: Hutong H Zentre 15 Middle Road Tsim Sha Tsui

places.name: Felix (The Peninsula)
places.intro: The Peninsula's rooftop restaurant and bar on the 28th floor, with harbour views.
places.reviews: Loved for the design and view, but listed hours vary by source and prices are hotel-level.
places.tips: Drinks only is fine; per OpenTable, drinks run 5:30pm to 1:30am.
places.address_en: 28/F, The Peninsula Hong Kong, 22 Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon
places.address_zh: 九龍尖沙咀梳士巴利道22號香港半島酒店28樓

places.name: Ozone (The Ritz-Carlton)
places.intro: Billed as one of the world's highest bars, on the 118th floor of the ICC tower.
places.reviews: The view is the draw; drinks are expensive, and it is a taxi or MTR ride (Kowloon station) from the ferry pier.
places.tips: Reserve through SevenRooms, or pair it with dinner at Tin Lung Heen on the 102nd floor.
places.address_en: 118/F, The Ritz-Carlton Hong Kong, International Commerce Centre, 1 Austin Road West, Kowloon
places.address_zh: 九龍柯士甸道西1號環球貿易廣場香港麗思卡爾頓酒店118樓

places.name: Tin Lung Heen (The Ritz-Carlton)
places.intro: A Cantonese restaurant with two Michelin stars (2026 guide) on the 102nd floor of the ICC.
places.reviews: The Michelin Guide praises the cooking and the views; it is formal and among the city's priciest Cantonese meals.
places.tips: Book weeks ahead for a window table; lunch is the best-value way to try it.
places.address_en: 102/F, The Ritz-Carlton Hong Kong, International Commerce Centre, 1 Austin Road West, Kowloon
places.address_zh: 九龍柯士甸道西1號環球貿易廣場香港麗思卡爾頓酒店102樓
places.maps_query: Tin Lung Heen Ritz-Carlton Hong Kong

places.name: Harbourside (Regent Hong Kong)
places.intro: A buffet restaurant at the water's edge with floor-to-ceiling windows and one of the widest harbour views in the city.
places.reviews: The view is the main draw; one 2024 blogger gave it 3 out of 5 for the food relative to the price.
places.tips: Smart casual (men need sleeved shirts); book through SevenRooms up to two months ahead.
places.address_en: G/F, Regent Hong Kong, 18 Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon
places.address_zh: 九龍尖沙咀梳士巴利道18號香港麗晶酒店地下

places.name: Mammy Pancake (Star Ferry Pier, TST)
places.name_zh: 媽咪雞蛋仔（尖沙咀天星碼頭）
places.intro: A takeaway egg-waffle stand inside the TST Star Ferry Pier, listed in the Michelin street-food selection from 2016 to 2021.
places.reviews: A popular quick snack; queues are common and it is takeaway only.
places.tips: Grab one straight off the ferry; the stand is open 11am to 10:30pm daily.
places.address_en: Shop KP-13, 29 & 30, G/F, Star Ferry Pier, Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon (MTR TST Exit L6)
places.address_zh: 香港尖沙咀梳士巴利道天星碼頭地下KP-13, 29&30舖
places.maps_query: Mammy Pancake Star Ferry Pier Tsim Sha Tsui

places.name: Peng Leng Jeng (Black Sheep)
places.cuisine: Hong Kong dai pai dong (wok-fried Cantonese)
places.intro: Black Sheep Restaurants' neon-lit, indoor take on a Hong Kong open-air street stall (dai pai dong), with wok-fried dishes, cold beer and Canto-pop; it began as a pop-up and is now permanent.
must_order: Black bean and chilli clams with fried mantou
Sweet and sour crispy chicken (HK$188 / HK$368 large)
places.reviews: Diners love the fun 90s-playlist atmosphere and punchy flavours; complaints are small portions, saucy dishes, dry or skimpy rice and loud music.
places.tips: Good for a group sharing many dishes; book through SevenRooms and ask about private hire, since the website has a separate events page for it.
places.address_en: 1/F, The Staunton, 22 Staunton Street, Soho, Central, Hong Kong
places.address_zh: 香港中環士丹頓街22號昇寓1樓
places.maps_query: Peng Leng Jeng 22 Staunton Street Central

places.name: Peking Garden (Alexandra House)
places.intro: A classic Beijing-style banquet restaurant run by Maxim's since 1978, best known for its Peking duck.
must_order: Beggar's chicken (pre-order a day ahead; you crack the clay with a mallet)
places.reviews: Reviewers often rate its duck as the best of the branches and less oily than elsewhere; mostly older reviews mention occasional slow service and waits for pre-ordered dishes.
places.tips: Reserve (SevenRooms 'pekinggardencentral'), pre-order beggar's chicken, and confirm the noodle demonstration time when booking.
places.address_en: Shop B1, Basement, Alexandra House, 16-20 Chater Road, Central, Hong Kong
places.address_zh: 香港中環遮打道16-20號歷山大廈地庫B1號舖

places.name: Peking Garden (Pacific Place)
places.intro: The recently renovated Admiralty branch, with modern interiors and an updated menu, right next to Admiralty MTR station.
must_order: Deep-fried yellow croaker in sweet and sour sauce
places.reviews: Reviewers like the refreshed room, but at least one found the food a notch below the Alexandra House branch.
places.tips: Open daily 11:30am-2:30pm and 5:30-10:30pm; it is the easiest branch to reach by MTR.
places.address_en: Shop 005, LG1, Pacific Place, 88 Queensway, Admiralty, Hong Kong
places.address_zh: 香港金鐘金鐘道88號太古廣場LG1樓005號舖

notes: Part A (Root) and the diamond_tips block were dropped at the user's request. Chow Tai Fook's Canton Road flagship soft-opened on 11 Feb 2026 and was formally unveiled on 15 May 2026 at Silvercord, 30 Canton Road. Ronald Abram says it closed its Mandarin Oriental salon and now sees clients by appointment at its Alexandra House office, but its contact page still shows the Mandarin address, and the 32/F suite comes from an HKTDC directory, so confirm when booking. Larry Jewelry, 'Kevin Ho' and 'Diamond Exchange' were left out: we found no reliable current retail address for Larry and no documentation at all for the other two. The Canton Library is real: it opened in Sept 2026 on 29/F One Peking (Aqua group, replacing Vista), and no Chinese brand name was found. Aqua and Hutong have moved from One Peking to H Zentre (17/F and 18/F). Mott 32 is in Central, not TST, so it was excluded. Peng Leng Jeng's Chinese address combines the official 中環士丹頓街22號1樓 with the building name 昇寓 (The Staunton) from the brief and the OneDay building listing. Peking Garden also has a Landmark (Central) branch and a TST branch. Most Peking Garden reviews of the noodle show and beggar's chicken date from 2008 to 2018. Phone numbers were left blank where not verified this session. Coordinates are approximate, taken from building locations.
